  <file path="src/routes/waitlist.ts">
    export const waitlistRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      const { waitlistService } = fastify.services;
    
      // Fire-and-forget (same posture as notifyAdded): a failed SMS must never fail
      // the seat/cancel that triggered it, and runs after the queue is recalculated.
      const notifyImproved: OnPositionsImproved = (changes) => {
        for (const change of changes) {
          fastify.waitlistNotifier.notifyPositionUpdate(change).catch(() => {
            // Already logged inside the notifier
          });
        }
      };
    
      // POST / — create waitlist entry
      fastify.post<{
        Body: {
          venueId: string;
          partySize: number;
          guestName: string;
          guestPhone: string;
          avgTurnTimeMinutes?: number;
        };
      }>(
        "/",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Add to waitlist",
            operationId: "createWaitlistEntry",
            tags: ["Waitlist"],
            body: createWaitlistBodyJsonSchema,
            response: {
              201: {
                type: "object",
                properties: { data: WaitlistEntrySchema },
              },
              400: { $ref: "Error#" },
              500: { $ref: "Error#" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: "body" }, async (request, reply) => {
          const { guestPhone } = request.body;
          if (!validatePhone(guestPhone)) {
            return reply
              .code(400)
              .send(createProblemDetails(400, "Bad Request", "Invalid phone number"));
          }
    
          const entry = await waitlistService.create(request.body);
    
          // Fire-and-forget: SMS delivery failures must not block the response
          fastify.waitlistNotifier
            .notifyAdded({
              id: entry.id,
              guestPhone: entry.guestPhone,
              guestName: entry.guestName,
              position: entry.position,
              estimatedWaitMinutes: entry.estimatedWaitMinutes,
            })
            .catch(() => {
              // Already logged inside the notifier
            });
    
          return reply.code(201).send({ data: entry });
        })
      );
    
      // GET / — list waiting entries for venue
      fastify.get<{
        Querystring: { venueId: string };
      }>(
        "/",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "List waitlist entries",
            operationId: "listWaitlistEntries",
            tags: ["Waitlist"],
            querystring: listWaitlistQueryJsonSchema,
            response: {
              200: {
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  data: { type: "array", items: WaitlistEntrySchema },
                },
              },
              400: { $ref: "Error#" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: "query" }, async (_request, reply, { venueId }) => {
          const entries = await waitlistService.withLiveEstimates(
            await waitlistService.listActive(venueId)
          );
          return reply.send({ data: entries });
        })
      );
    
      // GET /:id — get single entry
      fastify.get<{
        Params: { id: string };
      }>(
        "/:id",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Get waitlist entry",
            operationId: "getWaitlistEntry",
            tags: ["Waitlist"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["id"],
              properties: { id: { type: "string" } },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                type: "object",
                properties: { data: WaitlistEntrySchema },
              },
              404: { $ref: "Error#" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped(
          { venue: { ...entryVenue, load: (id) => waitlistService.getById(id) } },
          async (_request, reply, { entity }) => {
            const [live] = await waitlistService.withLiveEstimates([entity]);
            return reply.send({ data: live ?? entity });
          }
        )
      );
    
      // PUT /:id/notify — send "table ready" SMS and schedule 5-min claim window
      fastify.put<{
        Params: { id: string };
      }>(
        "/:id/notify",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Notify guest table is ready",
            operationId: "notifyWaitlistEntry",
            tags: ["Waitlist"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["id"],
              properties: { id: { type: "string" } },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                type: "object",
                properties: { data: WaitlistEntrySchema },
              },
              404: { $ref: "Error#" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped(
          { venue: { ...entryVenue, load: (id) => waitlistService.getById(id) } },
          async (_request, reply, { entity: entry }) => {
            await fastify.waitlistNotifier.notifyTableReady({
              id: entry.id,
              guestPhone: entry.guestPhone,
              guestName: entry.guestName,
              venueId: entry.venueId,
            });
    
            // Re-read so the response carries the persisted notified state.
            const current = await waitlistService.getById(entry.id);
            return reply.send({ data: current ?? entry });
          }
        )
      );
    
      // PUT /:id/seat — mark seated, recalculate remaining
      fastify.put<{
        Params: { id: string };
      }>(
        "/:id/seat",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Mark guest as seated",
            operationId: "seatWaitlistEntry",
            tags: ["Waitlist"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["id"],
              properties: { id: { type: "string" } },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                type: "object",
                properties: { data: WaitlistEntrySchema },
              },
              404: { $ref: "Error#" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: entryVenue }, async (request, reply) => {
          const entry = await waitlistService.seat(request.params.id, notifyImproved);
          if (!entry) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", ENTRY_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return reply.send({ data: entry });
        })
      );
    
      // PUT /:id/cancel — mark cancelled, recalculate remaining
      fastify.put<{
        Params: { id: string };
      }>(
        "/:id/cancel",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Cancel waitlist entry",
            operationId: "cancelWaitlistEntry",
            tags: ["Waitlist"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["id"],
              properties: { id: { type: "string" } },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                type: "object",
                properties: { data: WaitlistEntrySchema },
              },
              404: { $ref: "Error#" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: entryVenue }, async (request, reply) => {
          const entry = await waitlistService.cancel(request.params.id, notifyImproved);
          if (!entry) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", ENTRY_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return reply.send({ data: entry });
        })
      );
    
      // PUT /:id/expire — mark expired
      fastify.put<{
        Params: { id: string };
      }>(
        "/:id/expire",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Mark waitlist entry as expired",
            operationId: "expireWaitlistEntry",
            tags: ["Waitlist"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["id"],
              properties: { id: { type: "string" } },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                type: "object",
                properties: { data: WaitlistEntrySchema },
              },
              404: { $ref: "Error#" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: entryVenue }, async (request, reply) => {
          const entry = await waitlistService.expire(request.params.id);
          if (!entry) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", ENTRY_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return reply.send({ data: entry });
        })
      );
    };
  </file>
  <file path="src/routes/webhook-event-router.ts">
    type WebhookHandler<T extends Stripe.Event = Stripe.Event> = (event: T) => Promise<void>;
    export class WebhookEventRouter {
      private readonly handlers = new Map<string, WebhookHandler>();
    
      register<T extends Stripe.Event>(eventType: T["type"], handler: WebhookHandler<T>): this {
        this.handlers.set(eventType, handler as WebhookHandler);
        return this;
      }
    
      async dispatch(event: Stripe.Event): Promise<void> {
        const handler = this.handlers.get(event.type);
        if (!handler) {
          return;
        }
        await handler(event);
      }
    }
  </file>

  <file path="src/scripts/backfill-availability.ts">
    export interface BackfillSummary {
      apply: boolean;
      venues: number;
      counts: Record<string, number>;
      errors: { venueId: string; message: string }[];
      unrecognised: { venueId: string; reason: string }[];
    }
    type Log = (line: string) => void;
    export async function runBackfill(
      prisma: PrismaClient,
      options: { apply: boolean },
      log: Log
    ): Promise<BackfillSummary> {
      const venueIds = await getAllVenueIds(prisma);
      const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
      const errors: BackfillSummary["errors"] = [];
      const unrecognised: BackfillSummary["unrecognised"] = [];
    
      for (const venueId of venueIds) {
        try {
          const outcome: VenueMigrationOutcome = await migrateVenue(prisma, venueId, options);
          counts[outcome.outcome] = (counts[outcome.outcome] ?? 0) + 1;
          if (outcome.outcome === "unrecognised") {
            unrecognised.push({ venueId, reason: outcome.reason });
          }
          log(JSON.stringify(outcome));
        } catch (error) {
          const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
          errors.push({ venueId, message });
          log(JSON.stringify({ venueId, outcome: "error", message }));
        }
      }
      return { apply: options.apply, venues: venueIds.length, counts, errors, unrecognised };
    }
    async function main(): Promise<void> {
      const apply = process.argv.includes("--apply");
      const prisma = db.prisma as unknown as PrismaClient;
      try {
        const summary = await runBackfill(prisma, { apply }, (line) =>
          process.stdout.write(`${line}\n`)
        );
        process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ summary })}\n`);
        process.exitCode = summary.errors.length > 0 ? 1 : 0;
      } finally {
        await prisma.$disconnect();
      }
    }
  </file>

  <file path="src/services/assert-bookable.ts">
    export type BookableError =
      | { code: "PARTY_DOES_NOT_FIT"; message: string }
      | { code: "CONFLICT"; message: string }
      | { code: "PACING_EXCEEDED"; message: string };
    export interface AssertBookableOptions {
      /** Table being checked for conflict. */
      tableId: string;
      /**
       * The table's party-fit fields. Pass it wherever the caller names the table
       * (the server-picked path already filters by fit): the party must satisfy
       * partyFitsTable. Omit only when fit was settled earlier (hold confirmation,
       * whose hold was fit-checked at creation).
       */
      table?: PartyFitTable;
      /** Window to check — [startTime, endTime). */
      window: { startTime: Date; endTime: Date };
      /** Party size to add when computing pacing. */
      partySize: number;
      /** Venue pacing settings. */
      settings: VenueSettings | null | undefined;
      /** Pre-fetched reservation slices for the date. */
      reservations: ReservationSlim[];
      /** Pre-fetched hold slices for the date. */
      holds: HoldSlim[];
      /** Exclude this hold ID from conflict checks (used during confirmation). */
      excludeHoldId?: string;
      /** Exclude this session ID's holds from conflict checks (used during hold create). */
      excludeSessionId?: string;
    }
    export function assertBookable(opts: AssertBookableOptions): BookableError | undefined {
      const {
        tableId,
        window: { startTime, endTime },
        partySize,
        settings,
        holds,
        excludeHoldId,
        excludeSessionId,
      } = opts;
    
      if (opts.table && !partyFitsTable(opts.table, partySize)) {
        return {
          code: "PARTY_DOES_NOT_FIT",
          message: `Party size ${partySize} does not fit this table`,
        };
      }
    
      // Filter out the excluded hold so self-conflict is not flagged during confirmation.
      const filteredHolds = holds.filter((h) => {
        if (excludeHoldId !== undefined && h.id === excludeHoldId) return false;
        if (excludeSessionId !== undefined) {
          // Holds don't carry sessionId in the slim shape; this filter is a no-op
          // for the slim type but satisfies the contract — callers that need
          // session exclusion pass pre-filtered slices.
        }
        return true;
      });
    
      const hasConflict = checkTableConflict(
        tableId,
        startTime,
        endTime,
        opts.reservations,
        filteredHolds
      );
      if (hasConflict) {
        return { code: "CONFLICT", message: "Table is not available for this time slot" };
      }
    
      const pacingOk = checkPacingForSlot(
        startTime,
        partySize,
        settings,
        opts.reservations,
        filteredHolds
      );
      if (!pacingOk) {
        const maxCovers = settings?.pacingRules?.[0]?.maxCoversPerSlot;
        return {
          code: "PACING_EXCEEDED",
          message: `Pacing limit reached. Maximum ${maxCovers} covers per time window.`,
        };
      }
    
      return undefined;
    }

    export const APP_RESERVATIONS_ROLE = "app_reservations";
    export interface AppRoleClient {
      $executeRawUnsafe: (query: string) => Promise<number>;
    }
    export function appRoleSetStatement(role: string = APP_RESERVATIONS_ROLE): string {
      if (!APP_ROLE_PATTERN.test(role)) {
        throw new Error(`refusing SET LOCAL ROLE for ${role}`);
      }
      return `SET LOCAL ROLE "${role}"`;
    }
    export async function assumeAppRole(tx: AppRoleClient): Promise<void> {
      await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(appRoleSetStatement());
    }

  <file path="src/services/availability-migration.ts">
    export const MIGRATION_ACTOR = "system:availability-legacy-migration";
    export interface VenueForMigration {
      operatingHours: unknown;
      settings: unknown;
      ianaTimezone: string;
    }
    export type VenueMigrationPlan =
      | {
          kind: "migrate";
          shape: LegacyShape;
          config: AvailabilityConfig;
          notes: LegacyMigrationNotes;
          /** The legacy column derived from the rows; the seed writes it, the backfill does not. */
          projection: LegacyOperatingHours;
        }
      | { kind: "unrecognised"; reason: string; detail: string };
    export function civilDateIn(now: Date, timeZone: string): string {
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
        timeZone,
        year: "numeric",
        month: "2-digit",
        day: "2-digit",
      }).format(now);
    }
    export function planVenueMigration(
      venue: VenueForMigration,
      now: Date,
      newId: () => string = randomUUID
    ): VenueMigrationPlan {
      const normalised = normalizeLegacyHours(venue.operatingHours);
      if (!normalised.ok) {
        const detail = "detail" in normalised ? normalised.detail : "";
        return { kind: "unrecognised", reason: normalised.reason, detail };
      }
      const settings = (venue.settings ?? {}) as VenueSettings;
      const built = buildLegacyConfig({
        hours: normalised.hours,
        slotIntervalMinutes: settings.slotIntervalMinutes,
        lastSeatingBuffer: settings.lastSeatingBuffer,
        today: civilDateIn(now, venue.ianaTimezone),
        newId,
      });
      if (!built.ok) return { kind: "unrecognised", reason: built.reason, detail: built.detail };
      return {
        kind: "migrate",
        shape: normalised.shape,
        config: built.config,
        notes: built.notes,
        projection: projectLegacyOperatingHours(built.config),
      };
    }
    interface MigrationSummary {
      shape: LegacyShape;
      notes: LegacyMigrationNotes;
      rows: number;
    }
    export type VenueMigrationOutcome =
      | ({ venueId: string; outcome: "migrated"; operatingHours: unknown } & MigrationSummary)
      | ({ venueId: string; outcome: "would_migrate"; operatingHours: unknown } & MigrationSummary)
      | { venueId: string; outcome: "already_migrated"; operatingHours: unknown }
      | {
          venueId: string;
          outcome: "unrecognised";
          reason: string;
          detail: string;
          operatingHours: unknown;
        }
      | { venueId: string; outcome: "not_found" };
    export type AvailabilityRowWriter = Pick<
      PrismaClient,
      "schedule" | "venueService" | "scheduleService" | "scheduleAssignment" | "dateRule"
    >;
    export async function writeAvailabilityConfig(
      tx: AvailabilityRowWriter,
      venueId: string,
      config: AvailabilityConfig
    ): Promise<void> {
      await tx.schedule.createMany({
        data: config.schedules.map((s) => ({
          id: s.id,
          venueId,
          name: s.name,
          kind: s.kind,
          isRegular: s.isRegular,
        })),
      });
      await tx.venueService.createMany({
        data: config.venueServices.map((s) => ({
          id: s.id,
          venueId,
          name: s.name,
          position: s.position,
        })),
      });
      await tx.scheduleService.createMany({
        data: config.scheduleServices.map((s) => ({
          id: s.id,
          venueId,
          scheduleId: s.scheduleId,
          venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
          opensAt: s.opensAt,
          lastSeatingAt: s.lastSeatingAt,
          closesAt: s.closesAt,
          seating: s.seating,
          bookingTypes: s.bookingTypes,
        })),
      });
      await tx.scheduleAssignment.createMany({
        data: config.assignments.map((a) => ({
          id: a.id,
          venueId,
          scheduleId: a.scheduleId,
          weekdays: a.weekdays,
          precedence: a.precedence,
        })),
      });
      await tx.dateRule.createMany({
        data: config.dateRules.map((r) => ({
          id: r.id,
          venueId,
          kind: r.kind,
          targetKind: r.targetKind,
          startsOn: toDate(r.startsOn),
          endsOn: r.endsOn ? toDate(r.endsOn) : null,
          staffNote: r.staffNote ?? null,
          ...(r.kind === "special_hours" ? { payload: r.payload } : {}),
          createdBy: MIGRATION_ACTOR,
        })),
      });
    }
    export async function migrateVenue(
      prisma: PrismaClient,
      venueId: string,
      options: { apply: boolean; now?: Date }
    ): Promise<VenueMigrationOutcome> {
      const now = options.now ?? new Date();
      return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
        const venue = await tx.venue.findUnique({
          where: { id: venueId },
          select: { operatingHours: true, settings: true, ianaTimezone: true },
        });
        if (!venue) return { venueId, outcome: "not_found" as const };
    
        const { operatingHours } = venue;
    
        const existing = await tx.schedule.count({
          where: { venueId, isRegular: true, archivedAt: null },
        });
        if (existing > 0) return { venueId, outcome: "already_migrated" as const, operatingHours };
    
        const plan = planVenueMigration(venue, now);
        if (plan.kind === "unrecognised") {
          return {
            venueId,
            outcome: "unrecognised" as const,
            reason: plan.reason,
            detail: plan.detail,
            operatingHours,
          };
        }
        const summary = {
          venueId,
          operatingHours,
          shape: plan.shape,
          notes: plan.notes,
          rows: countRows(plan.config),
        };
        if (!options.apply) return { ...summary, outcome: "would_migrate" as const };
    
        await writeAvailabilityConfig(tx, venueId, plan.config);
        return { ...summary, outcome: "migrated" as const };
      });
    }

  <file path="src/services/availability-notices.ts">
    export const DEFAULT_CLOSURE_MESSAGE = "Closed on this date.";
    export const PAUSED_CALL_MESSAGE = "Online booking is paused right now.";
    export const PAUSED_MESSAGE = "Not taking reservations right now.";
    export interface DayNotices {
      closure?: AvailabilityClosure;
      bookingPaused?: BookingPaused;
    }
    function activePause(snapshot: BookingSnapshot, day: ReturnType<typeof resolveDay>) {
      const pausedRuleIds = new Set(
        day.closures
          .filter((band) => band.targetKind === "booking" && band.bookingTypes?.includes("online"))
          .map((band) => band.ruleId)
      );
      return snapshot.config.dateRules.find(
        (rule) =>
          pausedRuleIds.has(rule.id) && rule.kind === "closure" && rule.endsOn == null && !rule.window
      );
    }
    export function dayNotices(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      serviceDate: ServiceDate,
      phone: string | null,
      /** Online seatings `listSlots` found for the date, booked or not. */
      seatingCount: number
    ): DayNotices {
      const day = resolveDay(snapshot, serviceDate);
      const pause = activePause(snapshot, day);
      if (pause) {
        const phoneOpen =
          day.bookingOpen.phone && day.services.some((s) => s.bookingTypes.includes("phone"));
        const callable = phoneOpen && phone ? phone : undefined;
        const fallback = callable ? PAUSED_CALL_MESSAGE : PAUSED_MESSAGE;
        return {
          bookingPaused: {
            message: pause.guestMessage ?? fallback,
            ...(callable ? { phone: callable } : {}),
          },
        };
      }
      const closedByRule = day.closures.some((band) => band.targetKind !== "tables");
      if (!closedByRule) return {};
      // Any seating left on the online channel means the date is open, if shorter.
      if (seatingCount > 0) return {};
      return { closure: { message: day.guestMessage ?? DEFAULT_CLOSURE_MESSAGE } };
    }

  <file path="src/services/availability-snapshot.ts">
    export interface SnapshotWarning {
      table: string;
      id: string;
      reason: string;
    }
    export interface SnapshotLogger {
      warn(obj: object, msg: string): void;
    }
    type SnapshotDb = Pick<
      PrismaClient,
      | "venue"
      | "schedule"
      | "venueService"
      | "scheduleService"
      | "scheduleAssignment"
      | "dateRule"
      | "table"
      | "reservation"
      | "reservationHold"
    >;
    export interface LoadSnapshotOptions {
      /** Defaults to the venue-scoped service client; tests inject their own. */
      db?: SnapshotDb;
      /** Receives one `availability_snapshot_row_invalid` entry per warning. */
      logger?: SnapshotLogger;
    }
    export type SnapshotSource = "rows" | "legacy" | "none";
    export interface LoadedSnapshot {
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot;
      /** `Venue.availabilityVersion` at read time. */
      version: number;
      warnings: SnapshotWarning[];
      source: SnapshotSource;
      /** The venue's full settings (booking window, phone), beyond the engine's subset. */
      venueSettings: VenueSettings | null;
    }
    export class VenueNotFoundError extends Error {
      constructor(venueId: string) {
        super(`Venue ${venueId} not found`);
        this.name = "VenueNotFoundError";
      }
    }
    type RowSchema<T> = {
      safeParse(
        value: unknown
      ):
        | { success: true; data: T }
        | { success: false; error: { issues: readonly { path: PropertyKey[]; message: string }[] } };
    };
    function failureReason(issues: readonly { path: PropertyKey[]; message: string }[]): string {
      const first = issues[0];
      if (!first) return "invalid row";
      const path = first.path.map(String).join(".");
      return path ? `${path}: ${first.message}` : first.message;
    }
    function parseRows<T>(
      table: string,
      schema: RowSchema<T>,
      candidates: readonly { id: string; value: unknown }[],
      warnings: SnapshotWarning[],
      onInvalid?: (id: string, value: unknown) => T | null
    ): T[] {
      const parsed: T[] = [];
      for (const { id, value } of candidates) {
        const result = schema.safeParse(value);
        if (result.success) {
          parsed.push(result.data);
          continue;
        }
        warnings.push({ table, id, reason: failureReason(result.error.issues) });
        const replacement = onInvalid?.(id, value);
        if (replacement) parsed.push(replacement);
      }
      return parsed;
    }
    function failClosedRule(row: DateRuleRow): DateRule {
      return {
        kind: "closure",
        id: row.id,
        targetKind: "venue",
        startsOn: toServiceDate(row.startsOn),
        endsOn: row.endsOn ? toServiceDate(row.endsOn) : null,
        guestMessage: row.guestMessage,
      };
    }
    interface DateRuleRow {
      id: string;
      kind: string;
      targetKind: string;
      venueServiceId: string | null;
      bookingTypes: string[];
      startsOn: Date;
      endsOn: Date | null;
      repeat: unknown;
      window: unknown;
      payload: unknown;
      useScheduleId: string | null;
      seriesId: string | null;
      guestMessage: string | null;
      staffNote: string | null;
      expiresAt: Date | null;
      tables: { tableId: string }[];
    }
    function dateRuleCandidate(row: DateRuleRow): unknown {
      // The DB stores "no channels listed" as []; for a booking-target rule that means
      // every channel, but the engine reads [] as "affects nothing" — so spell it out.
      // validateConfig rejects the empty form on write; this is the defensive read.
      const bookingTypes =
        row.targetKind === "booking" && row.bookingTypes.length === 0
          ? [...ALL_RULE_CHANNELS]
          : row.bookingTypes;
      return {
        id: row.id,
        kind: row.kind,
        targetKind: row.targetKind,
        venueServiceId: row.venueServiceId,
        bookingTypes,
        tableIds: row.tables.map((t) => t.tableId),
        startsOn: toServiceDate(row.startsOn),
        endsOn: row.endsOn ? toServiceDate(row.endsOn) : null,
        repeat: row.repeat,
        window: row.window,
        payload: row.payload,
        useScheduleId: row.useScheduleId,
        seriesId: row.seriesId,
        guestMessage: row.guestMessage,
        staffNote: row.staffNote,
        expiresAt: toIso(row.expiresAt),
      };
    }
    interface LegacyVenue {
      operatingHours: unknown;
      settings: unknown;
      ianaTimezone: string;
    }
    function effectiveConfig(
      venueId: string,
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      venue: LegacyVenue,
      now: Date,
      warnings: SnapshotWarning[]
    ): { config: AvailabilityConfig; source: SnapshotSource } {
      if (hasRegularSchedule(config)) return { config, source: "rows" };
      const plan = planVenueMigration(venue, now);
      if (plan.kind === "migrate") {
        return {
          config: { ...plan.config, dateRules: [...plan.config.dateRules, ...config.dateRules] },
          source: "legacy",
        };
      }
      // "no_hours" is a venue with nothing configured, not a bad row.
      if (plan.reason !== "no_hours") {
        const reason = `legacy operatingHours ${plan.reason}${plan.detail ? `: ${plan.detail}` : ""}`;
        warnings.push({ table: "venues", id: venueId, reason });
      }
      return { config, source: "none" };
    }
    function pickEngineSettings(settings: VenueSettings | null): EngineSettings | null {
      if (!settings) return null;
      const {
        durationRules,
        defaultReservationDuration,
        pacingRules,
        slotIntervalMinutes,
        maxPartySize,
      } = settings;
      return {
        durationRules,
        defaultReservationDuration,
        pacingRules,
        slotIntervalMinutes,
        maxPartySize,
      };
    }
    export async function loadAvailabilitySnapshot(
      venueId: string,
      fromDate: ServiceDate,
      toDate: ServiceDate,
      now: Date,
      options: LoadSnapshotOptions = {}
    ): Promise<LoadedSnapshot> {
      const db = options.db ?? prisma;
      // ±1 day: a service that runs past midnight belongs to the day it opens on.
      const windowStart = new Date(addDays(fromDate, -1));
      const windowEnd = new Date(addDays(toDate, 1));
      const dayWindow = { gte: windowStart, lte: windowEnd };
    
      const [
        venue,
        schedules,
        venueServices,
        scheduleServices,
        assignments,
        dateRules,
        tables,
        reservations,
        holds,
      ] = await Promise.all([
        db.venue.findUnique({
          where: { id: venueId },
          select: {
            ianaTimezone: true,
            settings: true,
            availabilityVersion: true,
            operatingHours: true,
          },
        }),
        db.schedule.findMany({ where: { venueId } }),
        db.venueService.findMany({ where: { venueId }, orderBy: { position: "asc" } }),
        db.scheduleService.findMany({ where: { venueId } }),
        db.scheduleAssignment.findMany({ where: { venueId } }),
        db.dateRule.findMany({
          where: {
            venueId,
            deletedAt: null,
            startsOn: { lte: windowEnd },
            OR: [{ endsOn: null }, { endsOn: { gte: windowStart } }],
          },
          include: { tables: { select: { tableId: true } } },
        }),
        db.table.findMany({
          where: { venueId, isActive: true },
          orderBy: [{ priority: "desc" }, { capacity: "asc" }],
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            capacity: true,
            minCovers: true,
            maxCovers: true,
            isActive: true,
            priority: true,
          },
        }),
        db.reservation.findMany({
          where: { venueId, date: dayWindow, status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] } },
          select: { id: true, tableId: true, startTime: true, endTime: true, partySize: true },
        }),
        db.reservationHold.findMany({
          where: { venueId, date: dayWindow, expiresAt: activeHoldWindow(now) },
          select: {
            id: true,
            tableId: true,
            startTime: true,
            endTime: true,
            partySize: true,
            expiresAt: true,
          },
        }),
      ]);
    
      if (!venue) throw new VenueNotFoundError(venueId);
    
      const warnings: SnapshotWarning[] = [];
    
      const rowConfig = {
        schedules: parseRows<Schedule>(
          "schedules",
          ScheduleSchema,
          schedules.map((r) => ({
            id: r.id,
            value: { ...r, archivedAt: toIso(r.archivedAt) },
          })),
          warnings
        ),
        venueServices: parseRows<VenueService>(
          "venue_services",
          VenueServiceSchema,
          venueServices.map((r) => ({
            id: r.id,
            value: { ...r, archivedAt: toIso(r.archivedAt) },
          })),
          warnings
        ),
        scheduleServices: parseRows<ScheduleService>(
          "schedule_services",
          ScheduleServiceSchema,
          scheduleServices.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, value: r })),
          warnings
        ),
        assignments: parseRows<ScheduleAssignment>(
          "schedule_assignments",
          ScheduleAssignmentSchema,
          assignments.map((r) => ({
            id: r.id,
            value: {
              ...r,
              startsOn: r.startsOn ? toServiceDate(r.startsOn) : null,
              endsOn: r.endsOn ? toServiceDate(r.endsOn) : null,
            },
          })),
          warnings
        ),
        dateRules: parseRows<DateRule>(
          "date_rules",
          DateRuleSchema,
          dateRules.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, value: dateRuleCandidate(r) })),
          warnings,
          (id) => {
            const row = dateRules.find((r) => r.id === id);
            return row ? failClosedRule(row) : null;
          }
        ),
      };
    
      const { config, source } = effectiveConfig(venueId, rowConfig, venue, now, warnings);
    
      if (options.logger) {
        for (const warning of warnings) {
          options.logger.warn({ venueId, ...warning }, "availability_snapshot_row_invalid");
        }
      }
    
      const venueSettings = venue.settings as VenueSettings | null;
      return {
        snapshot: {
          timezone: venue.ianaTimezone,
          config,
          tables,
          reservations,
          holds,
          settings: pickEngineSettings(venueSettings),
        },
        version: venue.availabilityVersion,
        warnings,
        source,
        venueSettings,
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/services/availability.ts">
    export interface ListingOptions {
      /** Receives one warning per configuration row (or legacy column) that could not be read. */
      logger?: SnapshotLogger;
    }
    export interface DayAvailability {
      slots: TimeSlot[];
      closure?: AvailabilityClosure;
      bookingPaused?: BookingPaused;
    }
    async function loadOrNull(
      venueId: string,
      fromDate: string,
      toDate: string,
      now: Date,
      options: ListingOptions
    ): Promise<LoadedSnapshot | null> {
      try {
        return await loadAvailabilitySnapshot(venueId, fromDate, toDate, now, {
          logger: options.logger,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof VenueNotFoundError) return null;
        throw error;
      }
    }
    function withDuration(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      partySize: number,
      durationMinutes: number | undefined
    ): BookingSnapshot {
      if (durationMinutes === undefined) return snapshot;
      const rule = { minPartySize: partySize, maxPartySize: partySize, durationMinutes };
      return { ...snapshot, settings: { ...snapshot.settings, durationRules: [rule] } };
    }
    function toTimeSlot(slot: Slot): TimeSlot {
      const tables: AvailableTable[] = slot.tables.map((t) => ({
        id: t.id,
        name: t.name,
        capacity: t.capacity,
        minCovers: t.minCovers,
        maxCovers: t.maxCovers,
      }));
      return {
        time: slot.start.toISOString(),
        available: slot.available,
        tables: tables.length > 0 ? tables : undefined,
      };
    }
    function listDay(loaded: LoadedSnapshot, date: string, partySize: number, now: Date) {
      const { snapshot, venueSettings } = loaded;
      const seatings = listSlots(snapshot, date, partySize, "online", now);
      // No table could ever seat the party: offer no times at all, as before the engine.
      if (filterSuitableTables(snapshot.tables, partySize).length === 0) {
        return { seatings, offered: [] };
      }
      const window = bookingWindow(venueSettings, now, snapshot.timezone);
      return { seatings, offered: seatings.filter((s) => isSlotInBookingWindow(s.start, window)) };
    }
    function noticesFor(loaded: LoadedSnapshot, date: string, seatingCount: number) {
      return dayNotices(loaded.snapshot, date, loaded.venueSettings?.phone ?? null, seatingCount);
    }
    export async function getDayAvailability(
      venueId: string,
      date: string,
      partySize: number,
      durationOverride?: number,
      options: ListingOptions = {}
    ): Promise<DayAvailability> {
      const now = new Date();
      const loaded = await loadOrNull(venueId, date, date, now, options);
      if (!loaded) return { slots: [] };
      const timed = { ...loaded, snapshot: withDuration(loaded.snapshot, partySize, durationOverride) };
      const { seatings, offered } = listDay(timed, date, partySize, now);
      return { slots: offered.map(toTimeSlot), ...noticesFor(loaded, date, seatings.length) };
    }
    export async function generateTimeSlots(
      venueId: string,
      date: string,
      partySize: number,
      durationOverride?: number,
      options: ListingOptions = {}
    ): Promise<TimeSlot[]> {
      return (await getDayAvailability(venueId, date, partySize, durationOverride, options)).slots;
    }
    function rangeDates(startDate: string, endDate: string): string[] {
      const span = Math.ceil((Date.parse(endDate) - Date.parse(startDate)) / MS_PER_DAY);
      const days = Math.min(span, MAX_RANGE_DAYS);
      return days >= 0 ? Array.from({ length: days + 1 }, (_, i) => addDays(startDate, i)) : [];
    }
    export async function getAvailableDates(
      venueId: string,
      startDate: string,
      endDate: string,
      partySize: number,
      options: ListingOptions = {}
    ): Promise<DateAvailability[]> {
      const dates = rangeDates(startDate, endDate);
      const lastDate = dates.at(-1);
      const now = new Date();
      const loaded = lastDate ? await loadOrNull(venueId, startDate, lastDate, now, options) : null;
      if (!loaded) return dates.map((date) => ({ date, hasAvailability: false, slotCount: 0 }));
    
      return dates.map((date) => {
        const { seatings, offered } = listDay(loaded, date, partySize, now);
        const slotCount = offered.filter((s) => s.available).length;
        const { closure } = noticesFor(loaded, date, seatings.length);
        return { date, hasAvailability: slotCount > 0, slotCount, ...(closure ? { closure } : {}) };
      });
    }
    export async function findBestTable(
      venueId: string,
      date: string,
      startTime: Date,
      endTime: Date,
      partySize: number
    ): Promise<Table | null> {
      const tables = await findSuitableTables(venueId, partySize);
    
      const { reservations, holds } = await fetchConflictData(venueId, date);
    
      return selectBestTable(tables, startTime, endTime, reservations, holds) as Table | null;
    }
    async function findSuitableTables(venueId: string, partySize: number): Promise<Table[]> {
      // The party-fits rule (maxCovers ?? capacity as the ceiling) lives in one
      // place - @mbe/types' partyFitsTable - so it is applied here rather than
      // re-expressed as a Prisma `where`, where null maxCovers meant "unlimited".
      const tables = await prisma.table.findMany({
        where: { venueId, isActive: true },
        orderBy: [{ priority: "desc" }, { capacity: "asc" }],
      });
      return filterSuitableTables(tables, partySize);
    }
    export async function fetchConflictData(
      venueId: string,
      date: string
    ): Promise<{ reservations: ReservationSlim[]; holds: HoldSlim[] }> {
      const [reservations, holds] = await Promise.all([
        prisma.reservation.findMany({
          where: {
            venueId,
            date: new Date(date),
            status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] },
          },
          select: {
            id: true,
            tableId: true,
            startTime: true,
            endTime: true,
            partySize: true,
          },
        }),
        prisma.reservationHold.findMany({
          where: {
            venueId,
            date: new Date(date),
            expiresAt: activeHoldWindow(new Date()),
          },
          select: {
            id: true,
            tableId: true,
            startTime: true,
            endTime: true,
            partySize: true,
            expiresAt: true,
          },
        }),
      ]);
    
      return { reservations, holds };
    }
    export const availabilityService = {
      generateTimeSlots,
      getDayAvailability,
      getAvailableDates,
      findBestTable,
      fetchConflictData,
    };
  </file>
  <file path="src/services/book-slot.ts">
    export function tableAdvisoryLockSql(tableId: string): Prisma.Sql {
      return Prisma.sql`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(${tableId})::bigint)`;
    }
    export type SlotConflictCode = "CONFLICT" | "PACING_EXCEEDED" | "EXPIRED";
    export interface SlotConflict {
      code: SlotConflictCode;
      message: string;
    }
    export type SlotWriteResult<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; conflict: SlotConflict };
    export interface BookSlotIntent<T> {
      /** Table whose slot is written; keys the advisory lock and conflict re-check. */
      tableId: string;
      /** Venue for the pacing re-check; null/undefined skips pacing. */
      venueId?: string | null;
      /** Date-only used by the in-transaction conflict/pacing queries. */
      date: Date;
      /** Slot window — [startTime, endTime). */
      window: { startTime: Date; endTime: Date };
      /** Party size added when computing the pacing re-check. */
      partySize: number;
      /** Reservation excluded from the conflict re-check (moving an existing reservation). */
      excludeReservationId?: string;
      /** Hold excluded from the conflict/pacing re-check (confirming that hold). */
      excludeHoldId?: string;
      /** Session whose holds are excluded from the re-check (own session's holds during hold-create). */
      excludeSessionId?: string;
      /** Also re-check conflicting holds (not just reservations). */
      checkHoldConflict?: boolean;
      /** Re-check pacing under the lock. Requires venueId. */
      checkPacing?: boolean;
      /**
       * Runs immediately after the lock, before the conflict re-check. Returning a
       * {@link SlotConflict} short-circuits the write (e.g. a hold that expired
       * between lookup and acquiring the lock).
       */
      guard?: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<SlotConflict | undefined>;
      /**
       * Runs inside the transaction whenever the slot is unbookable (guard,
       * conflict, or pacing), before {@link bookSlot} returns — e.g. deleting the
       * hold that could not be confirmed.
       */
      onUnbookable?: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, conflict: SlotConflict) => Promise<void>;
      /** Performs the actual mutation once the slot is confirmed bookable. */
      write: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<T>;
    }
    export async function bookSlot<T>(intent: BookSlotIntent<T>): Promise<SlotWriteResult<T>> {
      const {
        tableId,
        venueId,
        date,
        window: { startTime, endTime },
        partySize,
        excludeReservationId,
        excludeHoldId,
        excludeSessionId,
        checkHoldConflict = false,
        checkPacing = false,
        guard,
        onUnbookable,
        write,
      } = intent;
    
      return prisma.$transaction(async (tx): Promise<SlotWriteResult<T>> => {
        // This `prisma.$transaction` call bypasses the per-call auto-wrap
        // `services/venue-scoped-prisma.ts` gives the `prisma` export — set
        // app.venue_id on THIS transaction's own `tx` explicitly (ADR-026 part
        // 6), using the intent's own (already-resolved) venueId.
        await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
    
        // Serialize conflict-checked writes per table BEFORE any conflict check so
        // concurrent slot writes cannot both pass and double-book. Released
        // automatically when the transaction ends.
        await tx.$executeRaw(tableAdvisoryLockSql(tableId));
    
        const fail = async (conflict: SlotConflict): Promise<SlotWriteResult<T>> => {
          if (onUnbookable) await onUnbookable(tx, conflict);
          return { ok: false, conflict };
        };
    
        if (guard) {
          const guardConflict = await guard(tx);
          if (guardConflict) return fail(guardConflict);
        }
    
        const conflictingReservation = await tx.reservation.findFirst({
          where: {
            tableId,
            date,
            status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] },
            ...overlapWindow(startTime, endTime),
            ...(excludeReservationId ? { id: { not: excludeReservationId } } : {}),
          },
          select: { id: true },
        });
        if (conflictingReservation) {
          return fail({ code: "CONFLICT", message: "Table is not available for this time slot" });
        }
    
        if (checkHoldConflict) {
          const conflictingHold = await tx.reservationHold.findFirst({
            where: {
              tableId,
              date,
              expiresAt: activeHoldWindow(new Date()),
              ...overlapWindow(startTime, endTime),
              ...(excludeHoldId ? { id: { not: excludeHoldId } } : {}),
              ...(excludeSessionId ? { sessionId: { not: excludeSessionId } } : {}),
            },
            select: { id: true },
          });
          if (conflictingHold) {
            return fail({ code: "CONFLICT", message: "Table is not available for this time slot" });
          }
        }
    
        if (checkPacing && venueId) {
          const now = new Date();
          const reservations = await tx.reservation.findMany({
            where: { venueId, date, status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] } },
            select: { id: true, tableId: true, startTime: true, endTime: true, partySize: true },
          });
          const holds = await tx.reservationHold.findMany({
            where: {
              venueId,
              date,
              expiresAt: activeHoldWindow(now),
              ...(excludeHoldId ? { id: { not: excludeHoldId } } : {}),
              ...(excludeSessionId ? { sessionId: { not: excludeSessionId } } : {}),
            },
            select: {
              id: true,
              tableId: true,
              startTime: true,
              endTime: true,
              partySize: true,
              expiresAt: true,
            },
          });
          const settings = (
            await tx.venue.findUnique({ where: { id: venueId }, select: { settings: true } })
          )?.settings as VenueSettings | null | undefined;
    
          const pacingOk = checkPacingForSlot(startTime, partySize, settings, reservations, holds);
          if (!pacingOk) {
            return fail({
              code: "PACING_EXCEEDED",
              message: "Pacing limit reached for this time slot",
            });
          }
        }
    
        const value = await write(tx);
        return { ok: true, value };
      });
    }

  <file path="src/services/booking-metrics.ts">
    export interface ReservationStatusCounts {
      pending: number;
      confirmed: number;
      cancelled: number;
      completed: number;
      noShow: number;
    }
    export interface DepositTransitionCounts {
      held: number;
      applied: number;
      refunded: number;
      forfeited: number;
    }
    export interface ReservationEventCounts {
      byKind: Record<ReservationEventKind, number>;
      rejectedTransitions: number;
    }
    export interface DailyBookingMetrics {
      date: string;
      venueId: string;
      reservations: ReservationStatusCounts;
      deposits: DepositTransitionCounts;
      events: ReservationEventCounts;
    }
    export interface GetDailyBookingMetricsParams {
      /** YYYY-MM-DD */
      date: string;
      venueId: string;
    }
    async function getDailyBookingMetrics(
      params: GetDailyBookingMetricsParams
    ): Promise<DailyBookingMetrics> {
      const { date, venueId } = params;
      // `Reservation.date` is a @db.Date column (no time component), so exact
      // equality on UTC midnight scopes to the whole day. Deposit transition
      // columns are full DateTime, so those need a [dayStart, dayEnd) range.
      const dayStart = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00.000Z`);
      const dayEnd = new Date(dayStart.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    
      const [reservationGroups, held, applied, refunded, forfeited, eventGroups] = await Promise.all([
        prisma.reservation.groupBy({
          by: ["status"],
          where: { venueId, date: dayStart },
          _count: true,
        }),
        prisma.deposit.count({
          where: { reservation: { venueId }, heldAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd } },
        }),
        prisma.deposit.count({
          where: { reservation: { venueId }, appliedAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd } },
        }),
        prisma.deposit.count({
          where: { reservation: { venueId }, refundedAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd } },
        }),
        prisma.deposit.count({
          where: { reservation: { venueId }, forfeitedAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd } },
        }),
        prisma.reservationEvent.groupBy({
          by: ["kind"],
          where: { venueId, createdAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd } },
          _count: true,
        }),
      ]);
    
      const reservations: ReservationStatusCounts = {
        pending: 0,
        confirmed: 0,
        cancelled: 0,
        completed: 0,
        noShow: 0,
      };
      for (const group of reservationGroups) {
        const key = RESERVATION_STATUS_KEYS[group.status];
        reservations[key] = group._count;
      }
    
      const byKind = Object.fromEntries(RESERVATION_EVENT_KINDS.map((kind) => [kind, 0])) as Record<
        ReservationEventKind,
        number
      >;
      for (const group of eventGroups) {
        if (group.kind in byKind) byKind[group.kind as ReservationEventKind] = group._count;
      }
    
      return {
        date,
        venueId,
        reservations,
        deposits: { held, applied, refunded, forfeited },
        events: { byKind, rejectedTransitions: byKind.transition_rejected },
      };
    }
    export const bookingMetricsService = { getDailyBookingMetrics };
  </file>

    export interface BriefingEntry extends Omit<Reservation, "guestEmail" | "guestPhone"> {
      guest: BriefingGuest | null;
    }
    export interface BriefingGuest {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      visitCount: number;
      lastVisit: string | null;
      dietaryRestrictions: string[] | null;
      notes: string | null;
      staffNotes: Array<{ text: string; createdBy: string; createdAt: string }>;
      tags: string[] | null;
      communicationPreference: Guest["communicationPreference"] | null;
    }
    export interface GetBriefingParams {
      date: string;
      venueId: string;
    }
    async function getBriefing(params: GetBriefingParams): Promise<BriefingEntry[]> {
      const { date, venueId } = params;
    
      const reservations = await prisma.reservation.findMany({
        where: {
          venueId,
          date: new Date(date),
          status: { in: ["PENDING", "CONFIRMED"] },
        },
        include: {
          table: true,
          guest: true,
        },
        orderBy: { startTime: "asc" },
      });
    
      return reservations.map((r) => {
        const guestData: BriefingGuest | null = r.guest
          ? {
              id: r.guest.id,
              name: r.guest.name,
              visitCount: r.guest.visitCount,
              lastVisit: r.guest.lastVisit?.toISOString() ?? null,
              dietaryRestrictions: r.guest.dietaryRestrictions as string[] | null,
              notes: r.guest.notes,
              staffNotes:
                (r.guest.staffNotes as Array<{
                  text: string;
                  createdBy: string;
                  createdAt: string;
                }> | null) ?? [],
              tags: r.guest.tags as string[] | null,
              communicationPreference: r.guest.communicationPreference as
                Guest["communicationPreference"] | null,
            }
          : null;
    
        return {
          id: r.id,
          date: r.date.toISOString(),
          startTime: r.startTime.toISOString(),
          endTime: r.endTime.toISOString(),
          partySize: r.partySize,
          status: r.status,
          notes: r.notes,
          cancellationReason: r.cancellationReason,
          cancellationNote: r.cancellationNote,
          guestName: r.guestName,
          guestId: r.guestId,
          userId: r.userId,
          occasion: r.occasion,
          seatingPreference: r.seatingPreference,
          tableId: r.tableId,
          table: r.table
            ? {
                id: r.table.id,
                name: r.table.name,
                tableNumber: r.table.tableNumber,
                capacity: r.table.capacity,
                minCovers: r.table.minCovers,
                maxCovers: r.table.maxCovers,
                location: r.table.location,
                isActive: r.table.isActive,
                priority: r.table.priority,
                status: r.table.status,
                venueId: r.table.venueId,
                floorPlanId: r.table.floorPlanId,
                shapeMetadata: r.table.shapeMetadata as Reservation["table"] extends infer T
                  ? T extends { shapeMetadata: infer S }
                    ? S
                    : never
                  : never,
                createdAt: r.table.createdAt.toISOString(),
                updatedAt: r.table.updatedAt.toISOString(),
              }
            : undefined,
          venueId: r.venueId,
          createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
          updatedAt: r.updatedAt.toISOString(),
          guest: guestData,
        };
      });
    }

  <file path="src/services/confirm-hold.ts">
    type ConfirmHoldErrorCode =
      "NOT_FOUND" | "EXPIRED" | "SESSION_MISMATCH" | "CONFLICT" | "PACING_EXCEEDED";
    export interface ConfirmHoldInput {
      holdId: string;
      sessionId?: string;
      guestDetails: ConfirmHoldRequest;
      userId?: string;
      /**
       * When provided, the hold must belong to this venue. Set by the slug-scoped
       * public route (#4487) so a hold id from one venue cannot be confirmed
       * through another venue's URL. A mismatch is reported as `NOT_FOUND`, never
       * as a distinct error — the caller must not learn the hold exists elsewhere.
       * Checked in the same lookup as the session id, before any write.
       */
      venueId?: string;
      /** Who confirmed; recorded on the `created` event. Defaults to {@link SYSTEM_ACTOR}. */
      actor?: ReservationEventActor;
    }
    export type ConfirmHoldResult =
      | { success: true; reservation: Reservation }
      | { success: false; error: string; errorCode: ConfirmHoldErrorCode };
    export async function confirmHold(input: ConfirmHoldInput): Promise<ConfirmHoldResult> {
      const { holdId, sessionId, guestDetails, userId, venueId, actor = SYSTEM_ACTOR } = input;
    
      // Step 1: Look up hold
      const hold = await prisma.reservationHold.findUnique({
        where: { id: holdId },
      });
    
      if (!hold) {
        return { success: false, error: "Hold not found", errorCode: "NOT_FOUND" };
      }
    
      // Step 1.5: Venue scoping (only when venueId is provided — slug-scoped public path)
      if (venueId !== undefined && hold.venueId !== venueId) {
        return { success: false, error: "Hold not found", errorCode: "NOT_FOUND" };
      }
    
      // Step 2: Session validation (only when sessionId is provided — internal path)
      if (sessionId !== undefined && hold.sessionId !== sessionId) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: "Session ID does not match the hold",
          errorCode: "SESSION_MISMATCH",
        };
      }
    
      // Step 2.5: Pacing pre-check — runs outside the transaction so pacing is
      // enforced on every confirm path, not just hold create. Fetch venue settings
      // and conflict slices once; pass to assertBookable (pure rule, no DB access).
      if (hold.venueId) {
        // ADR-026 §3.3 (sweep-discovered gap, #5369 PR 5): `venues` is RLS-scoped,
        // and `hold.venueId` is already a known, trusted scalar (the hold's own
        // column, not caller-supplied) — no ambiguity to resolve, so this reads
        // it inside that venue's own context rather than through `resolveVenueId`.
        const venue = await runWithVenueContext(hold.venueId, () =>
          prisma.venue.findUnique({ where: { id: hold.venueId } })
        );
        const settings = (venue?.settings ?? null) as VenueSettings | null;
        const dateStr = hold.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        const { reservations, holds: holdSlices } = await availabilityService.fetchConflictData(
          hold.venueId,
          dateStr
        );
    
        const bookingError = assertBookable({
          tableId: hold.tableId,
          window: { startTime: hold.startTime, endTime: hold.endTime },
          partySize: hold.partySize,
          settings,
          reservations,
          holds: holdSlices,
          excludeHoldId: holdId,
        });
    
        if (bookingError?.code === "PACING_EXCEEDED") {
          return { success: false, error: bookingError.message, errorCode: "PACING_EXCEEDED" };
        }
        // CONFLICT from assertBookable is a pre-check only; bookSlot re-checks under
        // the advisory lock, which is the authoritative gate.
      }
    
      // Step 3: Atomic slot write under the advisory lock + transaction.
      const result = await bookSlot({
        tableId: hold.tableId,
        venueId: hold.venueId,
        date: hold.date,
        window: { startTime: hold.startTime, endTime: hold.endTime },
        partySize: hold.partySize,
        excludeHoldId: holdId,
        checkHoldConflict: true,
        checkPacing: hold.venueId != null,
        // Re-check expiry under the lock so an expired hold never produces a
        // reservation, even if it expired between the lookup and acquiring the lock.
        guard: async () =>
          hold.expiresAt < new Date() ? { code: "EXPIRED", message: "Hold has expired" } : undefined,
        // Every unbookable outcome (expired, conflict, pacing) consumes the hold.
        onUnbookable: async (tx) => {
          await tx.reservationHold.delete({ where: { id: holdId } });
        },
        write: async (tx) => {
          const reservation = await tx.reservation.create({
            data: {
              date: hold.date,
              startTime: hold.startTime,
              endTime: hold.endTime,
              partySize: hold.partySize,
              tableId: hold.tableId,
              venueId: hold.venueId,
              guestName: guestDetails.guestName ?? null,
              guestEmail: guestDetails.guestEmail ?? null,
              guestPhone: guestDetails.guestPhone ?? null,
              guestId: guestDetails.guestId ?? null,
              notes: guestDetails.notes ?? null,
              occasion: guestDetails.occasion ?? null,
              seatingPreference: guestDetails.seatingPreference ?? null,
              userId: userId ?? null,
              // Ownership proof for the public deposit route (#6304).
              originSessionId: hold.sessionId,
              status: "CONFIRMED",
            },
            include: {
              table: true,
              guest: { select: { visitCount: true, communicationPreference: true } },
            },
          });
    
          await recordReservationEvent(tx, {
            reservationId: reservation.id,
            venueId: reservation.venueId,
            kind: "created",
            actor,
            from: null,
            to: toEventState(reservation),
          });
    
          // Delete the hold in the same transaction as the reservation insert.
          await tx.reservationHold.delete({ where: { id: holdId } });
    
          return reservation;
        },
      });
    
      if (!result.ok) {
        const { code } = result.conflict;
        if (code === "EXPIRED") {
          return { success: false, error: "Hold has expired", errorCode: "EXPIRED" };
        }
        if (code === "PACING_EXCEEDED") {
          return {
            success: false,
            error: "Pacing limit reached for this time slot",
            errorCode: "PACING_EXCEEDED",
          };
        }
        return { success: false, error: "Time slot is no longer available", errorCode: "CONFLICT" };
      }
    
      // Step 4: Map to domain type
      return { success: true, reservation: toReservation(result.value) };
    }
